body.query: query { personPathsToOrganization(sourcePersonId: "${person_id}", targetOrganizationId: "${organization_id}", pageInfo: {after: ${offset}, first: ${limit}}) { __typename ... on PersonPathsToOrganizationResponse { start { id name rolePrimaryTitle email } target { id name isRestricted } paths { __typename ... on DirectPersonToOrganizationPath { relationship1 { score relationshipStrength roleTitle email } } ... on FirstDegreePersonToOrganizationPath { relationship1 { score overlapTypes relationshipStrength } entity1 { id name rolePrimaryTitle } relationship2 { score relationshipStrength roleTitle } } ... on SecondDegreePersonToOrganizationPath { relationship1 { score overlapTypes relationshipStrength } entity1 { id name } relationship2 { score overlapTypes relationshipStrength } entity2 { id name } relationship3 { score relationshipStrength roleTitle } } } pageInfoResponse { totalCount pageInfo { endCursor } } } ... on SourceNotFoundError { sourceNotFoundErrorCode } ... on TargetNotFoundError { targetNotFoundErrorCode } ... on AuthorizationError { authorizationErrorCode } } }

person_id.description: Altrata id of the source person.

organization_id.description: Altrata id of the target organisation.

offset.description: Index to continue from: the previous page's pageInfoResponse.pageInfo.endCursor (0 for the first page).

output.description: Paths from the person to the organisation. The GraphQL response: `data` keyed by the query field (check its __typename for an error type such as GenericError or ValidationError) and, when something went wrong, `errors`.
